channel.description: New summaries and incidents confirmed by several sources in India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt.

item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
Opposition leaders and journalists were detained after marching to the Supreme Court and confronting police barricades in Delhi, while four men were killed by a landmine near the LoC in the Poonch area of Azad Kashmir. In Rajouri, a teenager died after his vehicle plunged off the road. In Manipur, the Border Security Force director general reviewed the security situation and operational preparedness amid fresh violence, and the state chief minister met with BJP legislators to discuss security and development priorities. The conflict continues across Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist-affected belt, with 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
